challenge.title: Why Traditional Poultry Operations Fall Behind
challenge.description: Modern poultry producers are under constant pressure from rising production costs, labour shortages, environmental variability and fragmented operational data. Together, these challenges reduce profitability, slow decision-making and make it increasingly difficult to scale operations efficiently.

operational.title: Operational Challenges
operational.subtitle: The daily operational inefficiencies that directly reduce farm profitability.

environmental.title: Environmental Challenges
environmental.subtitle: Environmental conditions change continuously and directly influence flock health and production performance.

decision.title: Decision Intelligence Challenges
decision.subtitle: Disconnected information prevents proactive operational decisions.

feed.title: Rising Feed Costs
feed.description: Feed represents the largest operating expense in poultry production. Even small improvements in feed conversion can significantly increase overall profitability.
feed.insight: Feed accounts for up to 70% of poultry production costs.

manual.title: Manual Farm Operations
manual.description: Daily inspections, reporting and monitoring still rely heavily on manual processes, slowing response times and increasing operational inconsistency.

env.title: Environmental Instability
env.description: Temperature, humidity, ammonia and CO₂ fluctuations directly affect bird welfare and production consistency.

waste.title: Water & Feed Waste
waste.description: Hidden waste often remains unnoticed until profitability has already been affected.

visibility.title: Limited Operational Visibility
visibility.description: Critical farm information is spread across sensors, spreadsheets and disconnected systems.

detection.title: Late Problem Detection
detection.description: Health issues, equipment failures and environmental risks are often detected after productivity has already declined.

consequences.title: The Cost of Inaction
consequences.description: Without real-time operational intelligence, poultry producers face higher production costs, inconsistent flock performance, delayed interventions and reduced profitability.

transition.title: The problem isn't collecting farm data.
transition.description: The real challenge is transforming thousands of daily farm events into timely operational decisions.
